detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

AOD9604

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C78H123N23O23S2
  • Molecular Weight: 1815.08 g/mol
  • Sequence: Tyr-Gly-Phe-Gly-Gly-Pro-Ser-Val-Thr-Leu-Leu-Lys-Gln-Leu
  • Molecular Structure
Product Description:

AOD9604 is a synthetic peptide analog derived from the C-terminal region (176–191) of human growth hormone (HGH), consisting of a defined amino acid sequence produced through controlled peptide synthesis. The compound incorporates structural modifications relative to the native fragment and is not identical to endogenous HGH or its naturally occurring derivatives. It is structurally characterized and utilized in laboratory research settings for analytical and experimental evaluation under controlled conditions. The compound is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling in research environments. No therapeutic, diagnostic, or clinical claims are made or implied.

Research Applications:

AOD9604 is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of peptide stability and degradation profiles under defined conditions
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and cell-based assay systems
  • Characterization of peptide interactions within controlled experimental models
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at -20°C until use.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Ensure aseptic handling to maintain purity and sterility.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

AOD9604 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
